name: TiboSEO
author: WebTibo

sections.description:
TiboSEO is a complete, lightweight SEO plugin that works on any WordPress site. Titles and meta templates, schema, breadcrumbs, an XML sitemap, redirects, a 404 log, social share tags and one-click import from other SEO plugins are all included, with no locked features and no external requests.

The content analysis follows the language of your content. For English it counts plural forms and uses the Flesch reading ease score; for other languages it matches the exact keyword and checks sentence length, paragraphs and subheadings. For Turkish it goes further. Turkish is an agglutinative language: one word can take many suffixes. Most SEO plugins analyze text with English rules, so when your focus keyword is “ayakkabı” (shoe), they do not count “ayakkabılar”, “ayakkabının” or “ayakkabıyı” in your text. TiboSEO recognizes Turkish suffixes, consonant softening (kitap → kitabı, renk → rengi) and vowel dropping (ağız → ağzı), so every inflected form of your keyword is counted correctly.

Content analysis that understands Turkish

  • Suffix-aware focus keyword analysis: Keyword in the SEO title, introduction, meta description, permalink, subheadings and image alt text, plus keyword density that counts every inflected form.
  • Keyword cannibalization warning: Shows other posts that already use the same focus keyword, including its inflected forms.
  • Turkish readability score: Uses the Ateşman formula, which was designed for Turkish. It also checks long sentences, passive voice, transition words, repeated sentence starts, paragraph length and subheading distribution.
  • Editor panel: A sidebar in the block editor and a box in the classic editor, with SEO, Readability, Social and Advanced tabs. Scores update while you type.
  • Google preview: Desktop and mobile search result previews with title and description length bars. Your keyword is highlighted.
  • Share preview: See how the post looks on Facebook, WhatsApp, LinkedIn and X, and set a separate share title, description and image.
  • Smart permalinks: Short, clean slugs from the title. Turkish characters are converted correctly and filler words such as “ve”, “ile” and “için” are removed. Slugs you type yourself and published URLs are never changed.

Technical SEO

  • Titles and meta templates: Templates with variables ({title}, {category}, {site}, {sep}…) for posts, pages, custom post types, categories, tags, authors, search results and the 404 page. Every post and term can override them.
  • Search appearance: Hide content types, taxonomies, author and date archives, internal search and paginated archives from search engines with one switch each. Attachment pages can redirect to their post.
  • Canonical, robots and nofollow: Clean canonical addresses with pagination, per-post noindex, nofollow and canonical fields.
  • Schema (structured data): One connected JSON-LD graph: Organization or Person with logo and social profiles, WebSite with a search box, WebPage, Article / BlogPosting / NewsArticle with the author, the primary image and breadcrumbs. Each post can pick its own schema type (FAQ, About, Contact page…).
  • Breadcrumbs: Breadcrumb structured data, plus a [tiboseo_breadcrumbs] shortcode and a tiboseo_breadcrumbs() function for themes.
  • XML sitemap: Builds on the fast WordPress core sitemap. Adds last-modified dates, leaves out hidden content and lets you choose what is included. /sitemap.xml leads to it.
  • Redirects: 301, 302, 307 and 410 redirects. When you change the permalink of a published post, a redirect from the old address is added automatically, without chains or loops.
  • 404 log: Lists the addresses visitors tried to open that do not exist, so you can redirect them. Only addresses are stored, no visitor data.
  • Open Graph and X cards: Share tags with image sizes, article dates and reading time.
  • Webmaster tools: Google Search Console, Bing, Yandex and Pinterest verification, and extra robots.txt lines.

Moving from another SEO plugin

TiboSEO imports SEO titles, descriptions, focus keywords, canonical addresses, noindex and share settings from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress and All in One SEO in one click. Only empty fields are filled, and nothing is deleted from the other plugin.

You can also keep using your current SEO plugin: while it is active, TiboSEO reads its title, description and focus keyword, adds only the Turkish analysis, and does not print duplicate tags.

Site dashboard

An SEO health score with a checklist that links to every fix, SEO and readability distribution for all content, a “TiboSEO” column in post lists, and one-click analysis of existing content.

Fast and private

All content analysis runs in your browser. The plugin makes no external requests, has no tracking and shows no ads in the admin panel.

Pro add-on

An optional Pro add-on is available separately at https://webtibo.com/eklentiler/tiboseo/. It adds internal link suggestions while you write, a list of older posts that could link to the current post, an orphan content report, a bulk SEO editor, local business schema and a Google News sitemap.

No feature of this plugin is locked, limited or time-restricted. It works fully on its own without the add-on.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins → Add New (search for “TiboSEO”), or upload the zip file.
  2. Go to TiboSEO → Dashboard and follow the checklist. If you used another SEO plugin, import its data under TiboSEO → Tools.
  3. Open any post. In the block editor, click the “TR” icon in the top right corner. In the classic editor, use the “TiboSEO” box below the content.
  4. Enter the focus keyword in its base form, for example “ayakkabı”. All inflected forms are counted automatically.
sections.faq:
Can I switch from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress or All in One SEO?

Yes. Go to TiboSEO → Tools and click “Import” next to your plugin. When the import is finished, deactivate the other plugin and TiboSEO takes over the titles, meta tags, schema and sitemap.

Can I use it together with another SEO plugin?

Yes. While Yoast SEO, Rank Math, SEOPress or All in One SEO is active, TiboSEO reads their title, description and focus keyword, adds only the Turkish analysis and does not print its own tags.

Which suffixes are recognized?

Plural, possessive and case suffixes, the most common derivational suffixes (-lı, -lık, -cı, -sız) and copula suffixes, in all vowel harmony forms. Consonant softening and vowel dropping at the end of the root are handled as well.

Does it change my existing URLs?

No. Smart permalinks are only created for new content whose slug is still empty. If you change the URL of a published post yourself, a redirect from the old address is added automatically.

How do I show breadcrumbs on my site?

Add the [tiboseo_breadcrumbs] shortcode where you want them, or call tiboseo_breadcrumbs() in your theme. WebTibo themes show them automatically.

Does the plugin send data to external servers?

No. The analysis runs in your browser, and scores, redirects and the 404 log are saved to your own database.

What is removed when I delete the plugin?

Settings, scores, redirects and the 404 log. SEO titles, descriptions and focus keywords stay with your posts so they are not lost.

Does it work for sites that are not in Turkish?

Yes. Titles, meta, schema, sitemap, redirects and the 404 log work for content in any language. The content analysis picks the language from your site settings (you can change it under TiboSEO → Content analysis): Turkish gets suffix-aware matching and the Ateşman score, English gets plural forms and the Flesch score, and other languages get exact keyword matching with the language-neutral checks. The interface is in English and a Turkish translation is available through WordPress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Plugins screen: Upgrade to Pro link also shown next to Documentation, Support and Rate the plugin.

1.1.0

  • Content analysis follows the language of your content: Turkish (suffix-aware, Ateşman), English (plural forms, Flesch reading ease, English passive voice and transition words) or other languages (exact matching). Choose it under TiboSEO → Content analysis; “Automatic” uses the site language.
  • Default permalink stop words follow the site language.

1.0.3

  • Plugin description updated: TiboSEO works on any site, with Turkish-aware content analysis.
  • Documentation, Support and Rate links in the plugins list, plus a “Get started” link.
  • More reliable data migration from pre-1.0.1 builds (also on SQLite).

1.0.2

  • Works without the mbstring PHP extension (UTF-8 safe fallbacks for string length and substring).

1.0.1

  • All functions, options, meta keys, tables and script handles now use the unique “tiboseo” prefix (existing data is migrated automatically).
  • JSON-LD output is hex-encoded for safety.
  • Translations are loaded by WordPress.org language packs.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
